2981-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2981-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-789-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

240-1115-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-1115-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5627-6662-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
5627-6662-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-5902-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Innkeeper's Talent
Repeat.

3330-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3330-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3375-4399-4518-7173.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

4091-4734-7791.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Cradle Clearcutter.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.

215-850-2079.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-2079.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4476-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4476-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1624-4668-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2113-2821-5479-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by remove a charge counter from it, untapping Minamo.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

804-2533-6913.notablePrerequisites: One of the two Clones must be on the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers, with the other in your graveyard.
804-2533-6913.description:
Activate the clone of Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the other clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Repeat.

3585-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2341-2495-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
2341-2495-5527.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Five Hundred Year Diary and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Five Hundred Year Diary and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-4222-6936.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Goblin Medics.
Goblin Medics triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

997-2178-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
997-2178-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1170-4211-6643.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Edgar this turn if Tormod's Crypt is in your graveyard.
1170-4211-6643.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your hand or graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Edgar.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2201-2558-5315-5687.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1283-2423-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2423-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Bounding Krasis.
Repeat.

575-4180-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-4180-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Lands.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Repeat.

3263-4078-4242-5070-5231.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
3263-4078-4242-5070-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

856-1201-1651-4321.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Food tokens, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Caludron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3350-3658.description:
At the beginning of the end step prior to your turn, Form of the Dragon's second ability triggers, causing your life total to become five.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality and Form of the Dragon's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, causing you and an opponent to swap life totals.
Resolve the Form of the Dragon trigger, dealing five damage to the opponent who you swapped life totals with.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.

338-1494-1841-1983.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Sage of Hours.
338-1494-1841-1983.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Celestial Force triggers, causing you to gain six life.
Sage of Hours triggers, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1409-3562.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator paired with Sky Hussar.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1409-3562.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Sky Hussar by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sky Hussar.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Deadeye Navigator's abilities to blink any number of creatures you control any number of times.

862-2232-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
862-2232-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

360-1610-1981-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least three.
360-1610-1981-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
Dingus Staff triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, causing you to create two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden twice, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
